title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and explore turns both ways with a clock-hand cue.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 reads a position scene. Q2 types how many quarter turns make a half turn. Q3 watches a quarter turn. Q4 orders the turns. Q5 taps every half-turn name. Q6 predicts a quarter turn both ways. Q7 and Q8 type how the parts fit. Q9 and Q10 perform a quarter turn each way.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, supported quarter turns and one performed quarter turn. Medium varies starts and uses the clock-hand cue for both ways. Hard adds three-quarter turns and four performed turns. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not only a bigger turn.
